say:2:1739900201:1.text: S-So sorry! I swear I'll tell you everything I know! I'll do whatever you say!
say:2:1739900201:1.source_cn: 我、我们错了……这位大人！从现在开始，我保证不还手，乖...
say:2:1739900201:1.male: S-So sorry! I swear I'll tell you everything I know! I'll do whatever you say!
say:2:1739900201:1.female: S-So sorry! I swear I'll tell you everything I know! I'll do whatever you say!

say:3:1739900202:1.text: Tsk, Fenn. You're such a spineless coward!
say:3:1739900202:1.source_cn: 唉，弗拉姆，你这个没骨气的！
say:3:1739900202:1.male: Tsk, Fenn. You're such a spineless coward!
say:3:1739900202:1.female: Tsk, Fenn. You're such a spineless coward!

say:4:1739900203:1.text: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!
say:4:1739900203:1.source_cn: 大哥，这不是保住小命要紧嘛！
say:4:1739900203:1.male: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!
say:4:1739900203:1.female: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!

choice_prompt:5:1739900203.text: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!
choice_prompt:5:1739900203.source_cn: 大哥，这不是保住小命要紧嘛！
choice_prompt:5:1739900203.male: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!
choice_prompt:5:1739900203.female: We've got to save our own skins, Sonne!

say:6:1739900204:1.text: W-We know... but we just got out of prison and needed money to get by.
say:6:1739900204:1.source_cn: 我、我们兄弟俩也知道……这不是刚从牢里出来，手头有点紧...
say:6:1739900204:1.male: W-We know... but we just got out of prison and needed money to get by.
say:6:1739900204:1.female: W-We know... but we just got out of prison and needed money to get by.

say:7:1739900205:1.text: We busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs just to pick through whatever the nobles left behind. Please, have mercy on us and let us go!
say:7:1739900205:1.source_cn: 我们辛辛苦苦地从北边的悬崖徒手爬上来，就为了捡点贵族老...
say:7:1739900205:1.male: We busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs just to pick through whatever the nobles left behind. Please, have mercy on us and let us go!
say:7:1739900205:1.female: We busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs just to pick through whatever the nobles left behind. Please, have mercy on us and let us go!

say:8:1739900208:1.text: How about we give you everything we found? Just look the other way and let us go, alright?
say:8:1739900208:1.source_cn: 大不了我们把找到的东西都给您，您就当今天没见过我们行不行？
say:8:1739900208:1.male: How about we give you everything we found? Just look the other way and let us go, alright?
say:8:1739900208:1.female: How about we give you everything we found? Just look the other way and let us go, alright?

say:9:1739900209:1.text: Fenn! ... Ugh, never mind. Those things aren't worth much anyway.
say:9:1739900209:1.source_cn: 弗拉姆，你……唉，算了，反正那些东西也不值什么钱。
say:9:1739900209:1.male: Fenn! ... Ugh, never mind. Those things aren't worth much anyway.
say:9:1739900209:1.female: Fenn! ... Ugh, never mind. Those things aren't worth much anyway.

picture:11::0.text: A journal once used by Orion, later left behind in Falcon Tower.
picture:11::0.source_cn: 奥利安曾经使用过的日记本，后来被他遗落在了鹰瞳之塔。

picture:12::0.text: A newly hatched bird. May it fly high and always be free.
picture:12::0.source_cn: 新生的雏鹰，愿你高飞，愿你自由。

say:13:1739900210:0.text: Just some odds and ends we found in that tower. They're all yours.
say:13:1739900210:0.source_cn: 是我们在那座塔里找到的一些小玩意儿，您既然喜欢，就留着吧。
say:13:1739900210:0.male: Just some odds and ends we found in that tower. They're all yours.
say:13:1739900210:0.female: Just some odds and ends we found in that tower. They're all yours.

say:14:1739900211:0.text: Um, we should just get out of your hair... Sonne, run!
say:14:1739900211:0.source_cn: 我们就不打扰了，哈哈……大哥，快跑！
say:14:1739900211:0.male: Um, we should just get out of your hair... Sonne, run!
say:14:1739900211:0.female: Um, we should just get out of your hair... Sonne, run!

choice:10:0:1.text: What have you got? Let me see.
choice:10:0:1.male: What have you got? Let me see.
choice:10:0:1.female: What have you got? Let me see.

choice:10:1:2.text: Oh? I'll take them off your hands, then.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 既然不值钱，就别留着了
choice:10:1:2.male: Oh? I'll take them off your hands, then.
choice:10:1:2.female: Oh? I'll take them off your hands, then.

choice:5:0:1.text: You shouldn't be snooping around here.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 这可不是你们该来的地方
choice:5:0:1.male: You shouldn't be snooping around here.
choice:5:0:1.female: You shouldn't be snooping around here.

say:16:1739900206:1.text: The south side is swarming with guards, so we busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs. We're just here to pick through whatever the nobles left behind!
say:16:1739900206:1.source_cn: 南边的守备军围得跟铁桶一样，我们是从北边的悬崖辛辛苦苦...
say:16:1739900206:1.male: The south side is swarming with guards, so we busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs. We're just here to pick through whatever the nobles left behind!
say:16:1739900206:1.female: The south side is swarming with guards, so we busted our backs climbing up the northern cliffs. We're just here to pick through whatever the nobles left behind!

say:17:1739900207:1.text: Please don't send us back where we came from! We only just got out!
say:17:1739900207:1.source_cn: 您可别再把我们兄弟两个关进老地方了，我们才刚出来不久呢！
say:17:1739900207:1.male: Please don't send us back where we came from! We only just got out!
say:17:1739900207:1.female: Please don't send us back where we came from! We only just got out!

choice:5:1:2.text: Tell me how you slipped in.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 老实交代，你们怎么溜进来的
choice:5:1:2.male: Tell me how you slipped in.
choice:5:1:2.female: Tell me how you slipped in.
